rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Pwntools is a widely used CTF framework and exploit development library for binary analysis and security research. This server wraps the pwntools Python library, exposing its capabilities for tasks like shellcoding, buffer overflow construction, format string exploitation, and ROP chain building. It enables security researchers to integrate pwntools functionality into their workflows programmatically.
